validation_method: Holm within pre-registered market/criterion-family/freeze-cohort/checkpoint; six fixed criterion families, three markets and three prospective looks; lifetime alpha spending 1/[k(k+1)]. Candidate selection uses only data coverage, sample size, distinct days, variable availability, rule simplicity and diversity. The 17,023+ exploratory tests and historical screening are not independent confirmatory evidence; only strictly post-freeze observations are evaluated.
warning: Exploratory screening and selection used historical data and cannot establish profitability. Holm and lifetime alpha budgets apply only to the fixed, pre-registered prospective families; signals require independent verification.
